image_description: A live concert performance on a large, elevated stage bathed in blue lighting. Three musicians are visible: a guitarist on the left, a central figure (possibly a singer or keyboardist), and a female vocalist on the right holding a microphone. Behind them is a drum kit and other musical equipment. The background features a large screen or backdrop with abstract visuals. The foreground shows the silhouettes of an audience crowd. Overhead, complex trussing and stage lighting rigs are visible.
